scope: Hermit choice/result presentation visibility timing and board status feedback cancellation

baseline.reproduced: Isolated real hermit component: a pending requestAnimationFrame delivered after 60 seconds hidden used absolute elapsed time, changed canvas and skipped enter timing. Regression assertion failed before source change.
baseline.productionDistinction: main.backgroundPause opens the pause menu and disposes the scene. In that existing route the scene restarts on Continue; isolated retained-scene jump is not claimed as a reproduced production failure.

changes: Visibility-aware lifecycle clock excludes each hidden interval; no rendering, sound or confirmation/continuation callback while hidden. Repeated visibility events do not double-count time.
Loading a scene while hidden starts its first frame only when visible. Hidden button callbacks are ignored. Actual dialog closure/removal cancels pending callbacks and removes visibility listeners.
HUD visibilitychange cancels pending status-removal feedback immediately, preserving existing active:false/modal/dice cancellation behavior and preventing delayed expiry audio after return.
Original onload/onerror then decode image loader and eight concurrent workers remain unchanged. No engine, rules or save format changes.

limitations: Component regression controls RAF/time/visibility for deterministic 60-second suspension; it is not an Android runtime performance measurement.
